messages:
maria: Quick thread — proposing onboarding rwd-v2p0-nf4-lite as a quant candidate for small-context chat. Want to agree canary + auto-fallback rules before we cut traffic. TL;DR: staged ramp + hard rollback on MRR/QA/latency/hallucination deltas.

kevin: +1. Can you drop the smoke numbers?

maria: Smoke vs baseline (rwd-v2p0 fp16):
- baseline MRR: 0.712 -> candidate MRR: 0.701 (-1.55%)
- baseline QA acc (longdoc slice): 86.1% -> candidate 85.2% (-1.04%)
- P50 latency: 68ms -> 52ms (win)
- P95 latency: 210ms -> 175ms (win)
Notes: small regressions in MRR/QA but within our tentative tolerance for this perf/cost trade.

anya: We should gate by hallucination on the customer-docs slice. If hallucination rate up >0.5pp (absolute), we rollback immediately. Also require no >1.5pp regressions on named-entity fidelity.

emily: Recommend shadowing for 24h on real traffic first (no traffic shift). Then staged ramp: 0.5% -> 3% -> 10% (6-12h windows) OR a faster 1% -> 5% -> 20% (12h windows) depending on early signal.

maria: My proposal config (starter):
```
canary:
  steps: [1, 5, 20]
  window_hours: 12
  shadow_for: 24h
  metrics:
    mrr_drop_pct: 2.5    # relative drop vs baseline triggers rollback
    qa_drop_pct: 3.0     # absolute percent points tolerated
    hallucination_delta_pp: 0.5
    latency_p95_ms_delta: 40
```

kevin: Quick note: for MRR we use rolling 6h comparison vs baseline cohort; ensure sample sizes >= 2000 requests for significance.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary job: job-id=cb-20260310-77, model=rwd-v2p0-nf4-lite, target=staging -> shadowing enabled

kevin: Ran a micro-eval against the anchor set (1000 queries):
```
anchor MRR: 0.712
candidate MRR: 0.704 (-1.12%)
longdoc acc: 86.1 -> 85.6 (-0.58pp)
hallucination est: 0.9% -> 1.2% (+0.3pp)
```
Not alarming but watch the hallucination delta on customer docs.

sam: I'll add automated rollback triggers in the rollout policy: if any of these fire for two consecutive windows -> auto-rollback + page on-call. Also adding a quiet window suppression (no rollbacks during infra flaps). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/quant-cutover

anya: For the named-entity slice, baseline fidelity = 92.4%. If candidate drops below 90.9% (>=1.5pp), do not promote.

emily: Also add a traffic-smoothing debounce so we don't flip if one window is noisy. Two-window confirmation required for non-latency signals.

maria: OK, updated config per comments and turned on shadow for 24h. Action items:
- kevin: monitor anchor MRR and hallucination, push alerts into slack channel if thresholds breached.
- sam: wire auto-rollback + page and add suppression rules.
- anya: prepare focused eval on customer-docs slice and named-entity fidelity.
- emily: finalize traffic ramp schedule (we'll decide 1%/5%/20% vs 0.5/3/10 after 24h shadow).

kevin: noted. will post early telemetry snapshot at +4h and +12h.

maria: thanks — will call a quick sync in 2h if we see any chatter. :thumbsup:

dev-bot: deploy-bot: canary shadowing live (0h elapsed) — job cb-20260310-77
